name: steps
label: Steps
help_text: Each step gets a numbered hex on the line, in this order. Keep titles short (about 20 characters) so they fit one or two lines.

default.title: Sellable
default.description: One live count of stock across every location, minus what’s promised or held back.

default.title: Routed
default.description: Your rules route each order to the location best placed to fill it.

default.title: Picked and packed
default.description: The team at that location scans each item, then picks and packs the order.

default.title: Shipped or picked up
default.description: Shipped with a label and tracking, or handed over at pickup.

default.title: Back on sale
default.description: Returns and exchanges go back into sellable stock as soon as they’re received.
